# sq-09 — squalify must profile Touchstone files and key=value/INI documents

Adds two text families.
- **`touchstone`** (v1 and v2): the option line, the port count, network data read as a flat token stream, v1 noise detection and the v2 keywords. The network data is exposed as synthesized numeric fields.
- **`keyValue`**: whole-file `key=value` or `key: value` documents, with optional `[section]` headers.

**Owner gate:** the owner supplies at least one real anonymized Touchstone file, or a file generated with the Obfuscator tool (link to follow from the owner), before the slice closes. The synthetic builders are enough to implement against.

**2026-11-02** — IBIS Touchstone 2.0 check (implementer, 2026-11-02; 2.1 has the same syntax per the IBIS summary, the 2.1 text itself was not read): the scikit-rf rules match IBIS on the 1+2N^2 / 1+N(N+1) block size, 21_12 as the v1 2-port order, [Two-Port Data Order] 12_21/21_12, Lower/Upper matrices, [Noise Data] for v2 and the 5-value noise line. Deviations or choices where they differ: (1) option line: IBIS allows any token order except R n, scikit-rf is positional; the profiler reads tokens by kind (accepts both). (2) v1 noise start: IBIS says the first noise frequency is <= the highest network frequency, scikit-rf uses a strict drop (values[0] < f[-1]); the profiler follows scikit-rf, so a noise block starting exactly at the last network frequency is read as network data. (3) 2-port Lower/Upper: IBIS says N11, N21, N22 for both; the profiler names them that way. (4) IBIS limits v1 lines to 4 pairs and v2 [Reference]/[Mixed-Mode Order] may span lines; the flat stream does not enforce the line width, and mixed-mode descriptors are not interpreted. (5) IBIS says noise only in 2-port files: a [Noise Data] keyword in another file is ignored and a frequency drop is nonMonotonicFrequency. (6) A file with a Touchstone extension but no option line or [Version] is not Touchstone (IBIS requires one; scikit-rf would default). (7) scikit-rf accepts any parameter letter for any port count; IBIS allows H and G for 2 ports only; the profiler accepts S Y Z H G for any. (8) Spec items needing owner attention: comment text has no model member, so it is offered only as hints.stableLines regexes under --include-values (preamble comment and text lines, first 100); noise fields are named noise.freq, noise.nfmin, noise.gammaOpt.mag, noise.gammaOpt.ang, noise.rn (the spec named them freq, nfmin, ... which would collide with freq); table.rowClasses became optional in the schema (listed as a widening); a Touchstone table has rows = network blocks and the noise fields have their own count.

**Not in this slice:** interpreting mixed-mode parameters beyond their names; HFSS `!` comment extensions (counted only); JSON and XML documents.

## Why

Goal: the v1 formats.

Owner decision (2026-10-13): key=value blocks above a table stay as sq-04's preamble. Whole-file key=value and INI documents are their own family.

DataBall's `TouchstoneHandler` only matches the extension (`DataBall/src/DataBall.Handlers/TouchstoneHandler.cs:12`), so squalify cannot reuse any parsing. The rules here follow scikit-rf's `skrf/io/touchstone.py`:
- the option line is positional, defaulting to `GHz S MA R 50`;
- `!` starts a comment, and inline comments are stripped;
- data is a flat token stream, with 1 + 2N² values per frequency;
- the port count comes from `[ghsyz](\d+)p`, or from `[Number of Ports]`;
- v1 2-port noise data starts where the frequency decreases;
- the v2 keywords are listed below.

They must be checked against the IBIS Touchstone 2.0/2.1 text.

Owner decisions (2026-11-02, spec check sq-09), verbatim: real sample "Synthetic only" (option text: "Drop the real-sample gate."); score band "keyValue scores 0.8 (Recommended)" (option text: "0.8 when at least 80% of non-blank, non-comment lines are key/value and there is no table-like run; delimited scoring and its goldens unchanged (prism relies on them). A CSV with a preamble stays delimited."); headerConvention "No, defer (Recommended)" (option text: "Adding it later is an additive minor."). Re-sized M to L. This supersedes the 2026-10-13 note's owner-supplied real sample before close and the Obfuscator link: fixtures are synthetic only, and `lab/owner-sample.s2p` gets no golden. Still use the local gitignored samples with `scripts/corpus-check.sh` as a reclassification guard (no file names or values in the repo). Spec check corrections: `./scripts/render-docs.sh` does not exist and there are no committed renders (AGENTS.md), so ignore that Check line; DataBall's TouchstoneHandler extension match is at line 15, not 12; `block` regions with `label: "noise"` need a new region `label` member (descriptor.md says block regions have no label), a schema addition the spec did not list; the four new issue codes (incompleteBlock, portMismatch, nonMonotonicFrequency, duplicateKey) go in the schema enum, descriptor.md and the sq-62 registry; the dialect list omits `noise`, which descriptor.md and TouchstoneDialect already have. This is the first schema-changing commit: `Descriptor.SchemaVersion` "1.1", `$id` v1.1.0 (CONTRIBUTING), every golden re-recorded, the hard-coded "1.0" in CompactFieldsTests, DescriptorWriterTests, SchemaValueTests and ApiSurfaceTests, PlannedMembersTests (drop touchstone/keyValue from the planned families), DocumentedMembers rows, the descriptor.md Changelog 1.1 entry. Added failing tests: `Registry_TouchstoneAndKeyValue_DoNotReclaimAnyExistingFixture`, `WhitespaceKeyValueDoc_ChoosesKeyValue_NotDelimited`, `Region_BlockLabel_Noise_InSchema`.

## Files

- `src/squalify/Touchstone/TouchstoneProfiler.cs`
  - **Score:** 0.9 when the extension matches `^\.[ghsyz](\d+)p$` or `.ts` and an option line or `[Version]` appears among the first non-comment lines. 0.7 for the content alone.
  - **`format.dialect`:**
    - `version` (`1.x` or `2.x`);
    - `ports`, from the extension or `[Number of Ports]` (a mismatch is the issue `portMismatch`);
    - `frequencyUnit`, `parameter`, `dataFormat`, `referenceOhms`, each defaulted with an evidence entry when missing;
    - `twoPortOrder`: `21_12` for v1 2-port files, or from `[Two-Port Data Order]`;
    - `matrixFormat`: Full by default;
    - `keywords[]`: the v2 keywords present, in file order. The known set is `[Version]`, `[Number of Ports]`, `[Two-Port Data Order]`, `[Number of Frequencies]`, `[Number of Noise Frequencies]`, `[Reference]`, `[Matrix Format]`, `[Mixed-Mode Order]`, `[Network Data]`, `[Noise Data]`, `[End]`.
  - **Data blocks:** the numeric token stream is split into blocks of 1 + 2N² values, or 1 + N(N+1) for Lower and Upper matrices, regardless of line breaks. `valuesPerLine {n: count}` is recorded.
  - **Regions:** `preamble` (comments, the option line and keywords), `data`, and `block` with `label: "noise"`.
  - **Synthesized fields:**
    - `freq`;
    - for each parameter in file order, `S11.<a>`, `S11.<b>`, and so on. For v1 2-port files the order is S11, S21, S12, S22. The suffixes depend on the format: `mag/ang` (MA), `db/ang` (DB), `re/im` (RI). The parameter letter follows `parameter`.
    - noise fields: `freq`, `nfmin`, `gammaOpt.mag`, `gammaOpt.ang`, `rn`.

    All of them go through `FieldAccumulator`.
  - **Comments:** comment text appears only with `--include-values`; comment counts are always included.
  - **Issues:** `incompleteBlock`, `portMismatch`, `nonMonotonicFrequency`.
- `src/squalify/KeyValue/KeyValueProfiler.cs`
  - **Score:** up to 0.6, when at least 80% of the lines that are neither blank nor comments are key/value pairs, and no delimited candidate scores above 0.6.
  - **`sections[] {name, line, keys[]}`:** names and keys are always included.
  - **Per key:** a type vote through `ValueClassifier`, giving a field profile per key (count 1, or N when a key repeats across sections).
  - **Issues:** `duplicateKey`.
  - Values only with `--include-values`.
- **Fingerprint contributions:**
  - Touchstone `layout`: version, ports, parameter, dataFormat, matrixFormat and whether noise is present.
  - keyValue `layout`: section names and keys, in order.
- `tests/squalify.Tests/Builders/TouchstoneBuilder.cs`: generates v1 and v2 files for a given N, format, line wrap and noise block.
- `docs/design.md` "Touchstone" and "Key=value / INI documents"; `docs/descriptor.md` dialects.
